purpose: Open the vendor context read-only after PWS-MD-001 and capture page/list/action/field context before any vendor write gate.
requiredPreparation: Port the PWS-MD-001 multi-checkpoint screenshot QA and frame-aware Role Center navigation pattern to the vendor read-first spec before live execution.
acceptanceCriteria: playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE context is proven before any vendor page interaction.
The vendor page/context is accepted only with visible page title and vendor-list or vendor-card signals.
Screenshots include enough checkpoints to show page context, Role Center link route if needed, list/card state, relevant actions and Page Inspection when available.
No vendor, template, bank detail, setup, document, draft, payment, Preview Posting, Posting or API shortcut is executed.
Result states what vendor context was observed and what remains unproven for vendor creation, purchasing, payments and posting.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: PWS-MD-001 observed Customer List (22, List) after learning that direct Page 22 can land on Role Center and the Debitoren link requires frame-aware navigation.
nextStepDecision.reason: Kreditoren are the next Master Data surface after Debitoren and support P2P, payment boundaries, training and data-request validation without creating records.
